propositions: A new LLM criterion 'ac-process-gate' must flag acceptance criteria whose entire completion predicate is a generic, ticket-agnostic mechanical gate enforced uniformly by CI or rebar (children-closed, tests/CI/build pass, plan-review pass, completion-verifier pass, merged, commit-trailer/DCO).

The criterion must accept and pass ACs that name or depend on ticket-specific deliverables (artifact, behavior, contract, test, doc, config, criterion), even when tests/CI/plan-review are the subject matter.
The ac-process-gate criterion is wired as a 1-TURN, advisory, non-codebase-grounded, ac-text-quality facet member registered in CANONICAL_LLM with container+leaf scope in criteria_routing.json.
Live bounded-sanity evaluation over the committed fire/no-fire corpus must achieve recall=1.0 (both process-gate ACs fire, both deliverable ACs pass) with kappa=1.0 consistency.
The criterion's deterministic registration, routing, front-matter, guide-section generation, eval-spec shape, and effectiveness-recorder auto-inclusion are pinned by unit test invariants.
A balanced chunk-packing fix was applied to prevent singleton chunks in the criteria registry when facet count % chunk-size == 1, and stale hard-coded criteria COUNT was removed from documentation.
